description: Remove the 65536-byte cap on spec requirements files from tests/spec_split.rs (spec files have no size cap)
no_spec_change_rationale: Test-only change: Chough bounds cover only its own .chough records (LIFE-15, REQ-cli-042); spec files have no size cap. No requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: tests/spec_split.rs no longer fails when a spec requirements file is over 65536 bytes; its wording and mapping tests still pass; the two split cases expect 4 passing tests; fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux with specs/cli/requirements.md over 65536 bytes.

answers.constraints: Leif (0xLeif) 2026-11-04 chose Remove the size test and said the size cap is only for the files inside the .chough folder, not for anything else. Test-only; weakens no other test or gate.
